notes_for_editor: No story written. The only source is the Canada Lookouts listing, which gives coordinates, elevation and region and nothing else. Two WebSearch queries returned nothing about this ridge. The firelookout.ca British Columbia index is a script-only page that shows no names, the Wikipedia fire lookout tower list does not name it, and the BC lookout geodata extracts on disk have no matching name. A story from the listing alone would be a few sentences, well under the 120-word floor, so it was left out rather than padded. Needs a human decision, or a later search of BC Forest Service annual reports or the BC Archives. The longitude is given as 124.184 with no sign on the listing; the tower record stores it as -124.184, which fits a site in British Columbia.
